claims.citation: New York Herald, 26 July 1866, p. 2, col. 6
claims.verbatim:
Ship Ceres (of Yarmouth), Humphrey, Shields, May 23[?],
with coal, to master. 2d inst lat 44 43, lon 50 18[?], was boarded
by a boat from schr Emily Elliott, of Provincetown, one
month out; had 200[?] quintals fish; also by a boat from schr
Orilolo[?], of same place, 1 month out, 300[?] quintals; 21st, lat
40[?] 48, lon 66[?] 40[?], signalized steamship City of Cork, hence for
Liverpool. Have been 22 days W of the Banks with light
WSW winds; saw no ice.

claims.citation: Lloyd's List, 7 August 1866, p. 4, col. 4 (British Newspaper Archive)
